1:1: “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations.
1:2: “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
3:16: A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.
6:19: 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
8:26: A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 1700 shekels is about 17 kilograms or 37.4 pounds.
9:21: “Beer” is Hebrew for “well”, i.e., a village named for its well.
17:5: teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property.
